description: The median registered price per square foot in a Dubai community SPLIT by whether the home was ready or off-plan, and by whether it is an apartment or a villa. Use this instead of a single median whenever the question is what something costs to buy, because 74% of Dubai home sales are off-plan and a blended figure is therefore mostly an off-plan price: on Palm Jumeirah the blend is about 3,645 AED/sqft against a ready market near 2,790 and an off-plan market near 5,483. PropertyIndex publishes an off-plan to ready ratio behind a paid tier; this returns the actual prices on both sides, free.

community.description: Community name, for example 'Palm Jumeirah', 'Dubai Marina'.

name: dubai_price_split
title: Ready vs off-plan, apartment vs villa, for a Dubai community
